title: fix(docs): preserve drawer traversal and reader focus on short screens
summary: Short-screen drawers keep hidden links out of Tab order and focused actions visible.
details: Exclude descendants of closed disclosures while preserving the first summary and expanded destinations, then scroll each focused action within its owning container.
Retain maintained landscape, RTL, modal-resize, new-page focus and fragment/history reader journeys as an independently required group.
